name: W Dubai - The Palm
positioning: The first W Escape in the Middle East: a Palm Jumeirah beach resort with a white-sand private beach, the WET Deck pool by the Arabian Sea and a Serenity by Sisley Paris spa
best_for: Travelers who want a lively Palm Jumeirah beach resort with a big pool scene
Couples and friends after design-heavy rooms with sea and skyline views

facts.text: All rooms have freestanding soaking tubs and standalone spacious showers.
Rooms have glass-tiled walls and urban-inspired graffiti.
Suite guests get a separate lounge area, a catwalk dining table and a large terrace.
Arabic calligraphy on the walls gives each suite a sense of place.
Serenity by Sisley Paris offers tailored massages, facials and skincare treatments.
Resident DJs spin at WET Deck.
The hotel has its own indoor squash courts.
Exercise classes include pole training above the city.
SoBe is the rooftop bar for sunset and city views.
Chef Akira Back's restaurant serves contemporary Japanese cuisine with Korean and international flavors, with Dubai skyline views.
The Kids Club is a space designed for children to explore and connect.
There is a children's pool, babysitting services and an arcade/games room.

highlights.text: The resort has a white-sand private beach on the Palm Jumeirah coastline.
WET Deck is the hotel's pool, with billowing cabanas and latticed lounge pods near the Arabian Sea.
Serenity by Sisley Paris is the first Sisley Paris Spa in the UAE.
The Marvelous Jacuzzi Suite has a private outdoor whirlpool on its balcony.
Premium rooms overlook the Arabian Sea, Palm Jumeirah and the Dubai skyline from a private balcony.

considerations.text: The hotel has a lively, party vibe.
The property attracts plenty of young, beautiful people.
Rooms do not have a work space.
